title: Real estate ontology
description: Portable real-estate semantics imported from the Lattice industry ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: real-estate
  title: Real Estate Ontology
  description: Shared property, party, lease, transaction, title, closing, management, and rent-roll semantics.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: real-estate-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:e4b18456eb9c227b95de046a723afd7da3da6eddc81d5798e4d6b9d68a6a8402
spec:
  types:
    - id: real_property
      label: Real Property
      description: A governed parcel, building, premises, or unit.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: real_property.property_address
          label: Property Address
          description: Property address.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: real_property.legal_description
          label: Legal Description
          description: Legal description of conveyed property.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: real_property.premises_description
          label: Premises Description
          description: Description of leased premises, suite, floor, or rentable area.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: real_property.property_name
          label: Property Name
          description: Property name.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: real_property.county
          label: County
          description: County of property or recording.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
        - id: real_property.included_personal_property
          label: Included Personal Property
          description: Personal property included in sale.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/5
        - id: real_property.occupancy_rate
          label: Occupancy Rate
          description: Occupancy rate percentage.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/6
        - id: real_property.state
          label: State
          description: State of property or recording.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/7
        - id: real_property.tax_parcel_number
          label: Tax Parcel Number
          description: Tax parcel or assessor number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/8
        - id: real_property.vacant_units
          label: Vacant Units
          description: Vacant units or suites.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/9
    - id: real_estate_party
      label: Real Estate Party
      description: A buyer, seller, owner, tenant, landlord, manager, or settlement party.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: real_estate_party.buyer_name
          label: Buyer Name
          description: Buyer name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: real_estate_party.seller_name
          label: Seller Name
          description: Seller name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: real_estate_party.tenant_name
          label: Tenant Name
          description: Tenant or lessee legal name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: real_estate_party.grantee_names
          label: Grantee Names
          description: Grantee names.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: real_estate_party.grantor_names
          label: Grantor Names
          description: Grantor names.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: real_estate_party.manager_name
          label: Manager Name
          description: Property manager legal name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
        - id: real_estate_party.tenant_entries
          label: Tenant Entries
          description: Tenant rows with unit, tenant, lease dates, area, rent, and arrears.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/6
        - id: real_estate_party.tenant_signer_name
          label: Tenant Signer Name
          description: Tenant signer name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/7
        - id: real_estate_party.landlord_name
          label: Landlord Name
          description: Landlord or lessor legal name.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/8
        - id: real_estate_party.owner_name
          label: Owner Name
          description: Property owner legal name.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/9
        - id: real_estate_party.title_company_name
          label: Title Company Name
          description: Escrow agent or title company.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/10
        - id: real_estate_party.buyer_cash_to_close
          label: Buyer Cash To Close
          description: Buyer cash to close.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/11
        - id: real_estate_party.guarantor_names
          label: Guarantor Names
          description: Lease guarantors.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/12
        - id: real_estate_party.proposed_insured
          label: Proposed Insured
          description: Proposed insured owner, lender, or policyholder.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/13
        - id: real_estate_party.seller_proceeds
          label: Seller Proceeds
          description: Seller net proceeds.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/14
        - id: real_estate_party.settlement_agent_name
          label: Settlement Agent Name
          description: Settlement agent, title company, or escrow officer.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/15
        - id: real_estate_party.tenant_signer_title
          label: Tenant Signer Title
          description: Tenant signer title.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/16
        - id: real_estate_party.vesting_owner
          label: Vesting Owner
          description: Current vested owner.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/17

      label: Lease
      description: A governed right to occupy real property under agreed terms.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: lease.lease_end_date
          label: Lease End Date
          description: Lease expiration date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: lease.base_rent_amount
          label: Base Rent Amount
          description: Base rent amount for the stated period.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: lease.current_monthly_rent
          label: Current Monthly Rent
          description: Current monthly rent.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: lease.monthly_scheduled_rent
          label: Monthly Scheduled Rent
          description: Total monthly scheduled rent.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: lease.rent_roll_date
          label: Rent Roll Date
          description: Date of rent roll.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
        - id: lease.lease_date
          label: Lease Date
          description: Date the lease was executed or made effective.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/5
        - id: lease.lease_start_date
          label: Lease Start Date
          description: Lease commencement date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/6
        - id: lease.renewal_options
          label: Renewal Options
          description: Renewal options, extension rights, or option terms.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/7
        - id: lease.security_deposit_amount
          label: Security Deposit Amount
          description: Security deposit amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/8
        - id: lease.assignment_subletting_terms
          label: Assignment Subletting Terms
          description: Assignment or subletting restrictions.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/9
        - id: lease.authority_to_collect_rent
          label: Authority To Collect Rent
          description: Whether manager is authorized to collect rent.
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/10
        - id: lease.rent_frequency
          label: Rent Frequency
          description: Monthly, annual, weekly, or other rent frequency.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/11
        - id: lease.use_clause
          label: Use Clause
          description: Permitted use clause.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/12
    - id: property_transaction
      label: Property Transaction
      description: A governed purchase, sale, financing, or transfer of real property.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: property_transaction.agreement_date
          label: Agreement Date
          description: Date of property management agreement.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: property_transaction.purchase_price
          label: Purchase Price
          description: Purchase price.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: property_transaction.closing_date
          label: Closing Date
          description: Closing date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: property_transaction.consideration_amount
          label: Consideration Amount
          description: Stated consideration amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: property_transaction.due_diligence_deadline
          label: Due Diligence Deadline
          description: Inspection or due diligence deadline.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: property_transaction.earnest_money_deposit
          label: Earnest Money Deposit
          description: Earnest money deposit amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
        - id: property_transaction.financing_contingency
          label: Financing Contingency
          description: Whether financing contingency is stated.
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/6
        - id: property_transaction.inspection_contingency
          label: Inspection Contingency
          description: Whether inspection contingency is stated.
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/7
        - id: property_transaction.transfer_tax_amount
          label: Transfer Tax Amount
          description: Transfer tax or documentary stamp amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/8

      label: Title Record
      description: A deed, title commitment, vesting, recording, requirement, or exception.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: title_record.commitment_date
          label: Commitment Date
          description: Title commitment date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: title_record.commitment_number
          label: Commitment Number
          description: Title commitment number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: title_record.deed_date
          label: Deed Date
          description: Date of deed.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: title_record.deed_type
          label: Deed Type
          description: Warranty deed, special warranty deed, quitclaim deed, grant deed, or other type.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: title_record.title_company_name
          label: Title Company Name
          description: Escrow agent or title company.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: title_record.estate_or_interest
          label: Estate Or Interest
          description: Estate or interest in land.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
        - id: title_record.recording_date
          label: Recording Date
          description: Recording date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/6
        - id: title_record.recording_number
          label: Recording Number
          description: Instrument, book/page, reception, or recording number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/7
        - id: title_record.recording_reference
          label: Recording Reference
          description: Recording information if stated.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/8
        - id: title_record.tenant_signer_title
          label: Tenant Signer Title
          description: Tenant signer title.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/9
        - id: title_record.title_charges
          label: Title Charges
          description: Title, escrow, recording, transfer tax, or settlement charges.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/10
        - id: title_record.vesting_owner
          label: Vesting Owner
          description: Current vested owner.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/11

      description: The settlement of a real estate transaction and its funds.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: closing.closing_statement_date
          label: Closing Statement Date
          description: Closing statement date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: closing.closing_date
          label: Closing Date
          description: Closing date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: closing.buyer_cash_to_close
          label: Buyer Cash To Close
          description: Buyer cash to close.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: closing.seller_proceeds
          label: Seller Proceeds
          description: Seller net proceeds.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: closing.settlement_agent_name
          label: Settlement Agent Name
          description: Settlement agent, title company, or escrow officer.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
    - id: property_management
      label: Property Management
      description: A governed arrangement for operating and reporting on real property.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: property_management.management_fee_terms
          label: Management Fee Terms
          description: Management fee percentage, amount, or formula.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: property_management.management_start_date
          label: Management Start Date
          description: Management start date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1

          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
        - id: property_management.authority_to_collect_rent
          label: Authority To Collect Rent
          description: Whether manager is authorized to collect rent.
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/3
        - id: property_management.bank_account_control

          required: false

          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/4
        - id: property_management.leasing_fee_terms
          label: Leasing Fee Terms

          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/5
        - id: property_management.management_end_date
          label: Management End Date
          description: Management expiration date or initial term end.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/6
        - id: property_management.reporting_requirements

          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/7

          label: Termination Notice Days

          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/8

      properties:

          dataType: decimal
          required: true

          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0

          dataType: date
          required: true

          required: true

          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2

          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/3
        - id: rent_roll.occupied_units_or_suites

          required: false

          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/4
        - id: rent_roll.report_preparer

          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/5
        - id: rent_roll.vacant_units
          label: Vacant Units
          description: Vacant units or suites.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/6

      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier

          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: organization

      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier

          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name

          required: true

        - id: organization.organization_type

          required: true

          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name

          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code

      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:

          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0

          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1

          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at

          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/3

      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:

          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
